summary: Well-structured two-tier test suite with comprehensive coverage of all major requirements: matrix generation, exclude/include rules, size validation, CLI invocation, workflow structure, actionlint validation, and end-to-end pipeline via act. Unit tests (MatrixGenerator.Tests.ps1) exercise core logic with good edge case coverage including empty matrices, boundary conditions, and error scenarios. Integration tests (Workflow.Tests.ps1) validate YAML structure, file references, and pipeline execution. Main gaps: some CLI parameter combinations untested (-Compress alone, -OutputPath alone), no stress tests for very large inputs, and could use deeper input validation coverage (non-array axis values, circular references, type mismatches). The two-tier approach with act integration provides strong confidence in catching regressions in core functionality and end-to-end pipeline behavior, though unusual input combinations might slip through.
